# Guest-ly

> Guest-ly is a wedding platform for couples and wedding planners, on the web and on iPhone. One payment per wedding, in US dollars.

This file lists only what is live in Guest-ly today and approved for public description. Facts as of 2026-11-08.
Spanish version: https://guest-ly.com/es/llms.txt
Short version: https://guest-ly.com/llms.txt

## Who it is for

- Couples planning their wedding.
- Wedding planners.
- Wedding planning agencies that work as a team.
- The guests of those weddings.

## Plans and prices

One payment per wedding, in US dollars (USD). Each plan includes 5 months live; after that, a fee of USD 20 per month keeps the website, RSVP and concierge running, only if the couple wants it.

- Essentials: USD 199. Up to 160 guests.
- Signature: USD 399. Up to 300 guests.
- Grande: USD 699. 500+ guests. The AI Coordinator is included.
- AI Coordinator add-on for Essentials and Signature: USD 79 once, or USD 19 per month.

Plans and ordering: https://guest-ly.com/#pricing

## What it does for couples

### Wedding website builder

A bilingual wedding site with schedule, travel, registry, FAQ, RSVP, chat, gallery and custom sections, in three themes.

- A wedding website with RSVP, in three themes.

Where: the wedding website, the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Site privacy controls

An optional site password and a switch to hide the site from search engines.

Where: the wedding website, the couple portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Dashboard and analytics

Questions answered, guests reached, busy hours, top questions by topic and the gaps to fix.

- See what guests are asking.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Wedding info

The couple edits the facts the WhatsApp assistant answers from; publishing updates it in about a minute, with version history.

- Edit, preview and publish what the concierge knows.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Conversations

Every guest chat with the WhatsApp assistant, word for word, with search and topic labels; the couple can answer when the channel allows.

- Read every question your guests asked, word for word.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Guest list

Parties with named members, tags, notes, plus-ones and a language per guest, edited from one guest drawer.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Guest import

Bring a list in from Zola, The Knot, Joy, Minted, a spreadsheet, a photo, a PDF or pasted text; unsure rows wait for review.

- Import your Zola guest list.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### RSVP board and chase list

Live status, headcounts per event, a list of who has not answered, and a way to record an RSVP received by phone.

- Headcounts count people, not replies.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Tasks and checklist

A wedding checklist with owners, priorities and email reminders, shareable with people who have no login.

- A wedding checklist with owners and reminders.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app, email.

Plans: every plan.

### Budget with AI import

Categories, items, payments and what is still owed; import from Excel, pasted text or a photo, nothing saved until confirmed.

- Import a budget from Excel, pasted text or a photo. You confirm before anything is saved.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Seating planner

Upload a photo of the floor plan, let the AI suggest the tables, then seat parties by dragging, with undo, and print.

- Start from a photo of the floor plan.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Vendors and day-of runsheet

A vendor list linked to budget lines and a minute-by-minute schedule for the wedding day with calendar export.

- A minute-by-minute runsheet for the wedding day.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Door check-in

Scan a guest's QR pass on any phone or search by name, with live counters and undo.

- In the iOS app it keeps working without signal.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Branded Excel exports

Styled spreadsheets with several presets, for example one for the caterer.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Email alerts and weekly digest

RSVP alerts by email and a weekly summary of what guests asked.

Where: email.

Plans: every plan.

### Couple guide

An illustrated how-to inside the portal.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Requests, approvals and contact privacy

A planner proposes a change and the couple approves it, or lets the planner edit; the couple decides who sees phones and emails.

- Privacy-controlled: the couple decides what the planner sees.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Live demo chat on guest-ly.com

A real assistant on a fictional wedding (Emma and James) in the hero of guest-ly.com, limited to a few messages.

- A real concierge on a fictional wedding. Try the demo.

Where: the wedding website.

Plans: every plan.

### Sign in with Google, Apple, email link or password

Couples and planners sign in to the portal and the app with Google, Apple, an emailed link or a password.

- Sign in with Google or Apple.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Global search

One search box (Cmd+K) across guests, RSVPs, tasks, messages and seating tables.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Notification bell, daily briefing and risk alerts

A bell with what needs attention, a daily briefing on the home screen and alerts when something is at risk.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Topic labels on every conversation

Each guest conversation gets topic labels, so couples see what guests ask about and what is still unanswered.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### RSVP change history per guest

Every RSVP change made in the portal is confirmed first and recorded, so the guest drawer shows who changed what and when.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Seating suggestions and seating chart PDF

Suggest seating groups parties by relationship and tags and explains who stays unseated; export a branded PDF of the chart.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Update a budget from a newer file

Upload a newer version of the budget spreadsheet, see exactly what changes, then apply it.

Where: the couple portal on the web, the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

## What it does for planners

### Planner portal

A separate, role-scoped portal for wedding planners with a home, guests, requests, budget and tasks.

Where: the planner portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Per-wedding, per-tool permissions

For each planner and each wedding, every tool is off, view or edit; a tool that is off disappears from the menu.

Where: the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Logistics and transport manifest

Lodging, arrival, transport, pickup point and diet per guest, with a manifest export and quick answers.

Where: the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Planner assistant

A chat helper that answers from the wedding's real data and can make changes behind confirm cards.

- Changes always wait for confirmation.

Where: the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Request a new wedding

A planner fills in an intake form, or sends the couple a link to fill it in, and Guest-ly builds the wedding.

Where: the planner portal on the web, the couple portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Meeting intake from a transcript

A planner pastes or uploads a meeting transcript and reviews a proposed draft section by section before anything is saved.

- Upload a meeting transcript and review a draft, section by section.

Where: the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

## What it does for agencies

### Agency workspace

A planning company sees all its weddings in one place, with what needs attention, team seats and documents.

Where: the planner portal on the web.

Plans: every plan.

## What it does for guests

### Web assistant chat

Guests ask anything about the wedding on its page or chat link and get answers from the couple's own facts.

- Guests ask the concierge anything, any hour, in their language.
- It is an AI assistant and says so.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Answers only from the couple's facts, and flags gaps

The WhatsApp assistant never invents facts. When unsure it says it is checking, and the question lands on the dashboard as a gap to fix.

- Trained only on the couple's wedding.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web, the couple portal on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Replies in the guest's language

The WhatsApp assistant answers in the language the guest writes in: perfected in English and Spanish, best effort in other languages.

- Understands 30+ languages, perfected in English and Spanish.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web, WhatsApp, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### RSVP inside the web chat

A guest says they are coming; the WhatsApp assistant matches the guest list and asks person by person and event by event.

- RSVP person by person, event by event, right in the chat.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### International guest guide

Visas, currency, weather and transport answered from the couple's own facts, in the guest's language.

- Visas, currency, weather and transport.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### RSVP wizard with personal links

A shareable RSVP page with a personal link per guest: answers per person and per event, plus the couple's own questions.

- Per-person, per-event RSVP. Headcounts count people, not replies.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Add to calendar

Per-event calendar files and Google Calendar links with the right time zone.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### QR guest pass

A printable pass with a QR code for each guest, scanned at the door.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Hosted registry page

A registry page with link cards, notes and QR images, or a link out to the couple's registry elsewhere.

Where: the wedding website, guest pages on the web.

Plans: every plan.

### Guest-ly iOS app

One free iPhone app in English and Spanish for guests, couples and planners, a companion to a wedding set up at guest-ly.com.

- Free on the App Store for iPhone, in English and Spanish.
- A companion to a wedding set up at guest-ly.com.

Where: the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Push notifications in the app

Device notifications for guests, couples and planners.

Where: the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.

### Wedding Code on every site

Every published wedding site shows its Wedding Code and an open-in-app link, so guests open the invitation in the app.

- Open the invitation in the Guest-ly app with the wedding's code.

Where: the wedding website, the iPhone app.

Plans: every plan.
